meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.base: RBI bank groups, as on 31 March
meta.coverage: Bad loans: gross and net non-performing assets as a share of advances and of assets, for all scheduled commercial banks and each bank group, every March since 1997
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 330 (Gross and Net NPAs of Scheduled Commercial Banks, bank group-wise), per cent, as published. Bank groups change: old and new private banks are reported apart until March 2013 and together from March 2014 (under the label "New Private Sector Banks"); small finance banks appear from March 2019. 56 values of the pre-2011 "Private Sector Banks" row that are the sum of two ratios, not a ratio, are dropped.
